$comment: Watched dependabot ignores. A dependabot `ignore` is permanent and silent — nothing re-nudges us when upstream catches up. For each entry, the dependency-ignore-watch workflow polls npm for the gating package's peerDependencies range; when that range admits the blocked major, it opens an issue to RE-TEST and remove the ignore. A peerDep claim means 'upstream now declares support' (re-test trigger), NOT 'the upgrade definitely works' — confirm on a test branch. To add an entry: mirror the shape below and add the matching ignore in .github/dependabot.yml. See docs/runbooks/dependency-ignore-watch.md.
